units.source_text: 小皇子的母亲是更衣，按照身份，本来不须像普通低级女官这样侍候皇上日常生活。

en.t: The young prince's mother was a lower-ranking consort, but by her status she should not have had to attend to the emperor's daily life like an ordinary low-ranking court lady.

units.source_text: 她的地位并不寻常，品格也很高贵。

en.t: Her position was far from ordinary, and her character was also very noble.

units.source_text: 然而皇上对她过分宠爱，不讲情理，只管要她住在身边，几乎片刻不离。

en.t: Yet the emperor loved her to excess, beyond all reason, and insisted on keeping her at his side, scarcely letting her leave him for even a moment.

units.source_text: 结果每逢开宴作乐，以及其他盛会佳节，总是首先宣召这更衣。

en.t: As a result, whenever banquets, music, grand gatherings, or festive occasions were held, this consort was always the first to be summoned.

units.source_text: 有时皇上起身很迟，这一天就把这更衣留在身边，不放她回自己宫室去。

en.t: Sometimes, when the emperor rose very late, he would keep this consort with him for the whole day and would not let her return to her own chambers.

units.source_text: 如此日夜侍候，照更衣身份而言，似乎反而太轻率了。

en.t: For her to serve him day and night in this way seemed, considering her rank as a consort, almost too careless and improper.

units.source_text: 自小皇子诞生之后，皇上对此更衣尤其重视，使得大皇子的母亲弘徽殿女御心怀疑忌。

en.t: After the young prince was born, the emperor valued this consort even more, causing the mother of the elder prince, the Kokiden consort, to harbor suspicion and jealousy.

units.source_text: 她想：这小皇子可能立为太子呢。

en.t: She thought that this young prince might be made crown prince.
